column39: BA is a dual-function single floral volatile: known pollinator attractant and experimentally demonstrated florivore deterrent. It is coded as D_to_antagonism here but is not split into artificial A and D axes for direct interaction. Source reports greater CHAL colonization than EV in 2011 (52.9% vs 17.6%, P=0.035) and 2014 (37.1% vs 10.3%, P=0.013); 2016 direction was similar but unresolved (23.1% vs 0%, P=0.098). Exact year-specific sample sizes are not inferred from rounded percentages. EDMOND audit is active before any SE-bearing reconstruction.
